title: REA Environments on AgentEnv
description: 50 RL environments REA built from recorded browser sessions of 43 self-hosted apps and 7 public APIs, replayed as MCP tools on AgentEnv.
attribution: Environments by earakely-scale (Edgar Arakelyan / Scale Labs). Catalog mirrored on rea.run for REA community teaching; not affiliated. Datasets remain on Hugging Face.

items.title: REA Environments on AgentEnv
items.note: Start here: what these 44 environments are, how REA builds them, baseline results for two models, and a filterable gallery of all of them.
items.shortDescription: 50 replay environments REA built from app sessions

items.title: GiteaEnv-REA
items.note: Developer & infrastructure · Gitea 28.1.0 (MIT), self-hosted on synthetic data. Git hosting, issues and code review. 77 tools, 12 retrieval tasks; gpt-oss-120b 12/12, GLM-5.3-Flash 11/12. Captured as a HAR.
